description: Sub-workflow called by 'Content agent: lark' when the manager sends screenshots that are not a reply to a draft card: one message is one post. Reads each screenshot with DeepSeek (deepseek-flash, vision), merges what they show (author, text, counts, comments, time, link, format), writes why the post works, saves it to content_agent.inspiring_facebook_posts with the manager's text as notes, records it for the agent and replies in Lark.
name: Content agent: capture

messageValues.message:
You read one screenshot of a social media post, usually Facebook and usually in Vietnamese, and write down what is visible. Never invent anything that is not in the image.

Answer with JSON only, in this shape:
{"is_post": true, "author_name": "", "source_type": "page|profile|group or empty", "posted_ago": "", "posted_at": "", "text": "", "cut_off": false, "reaction_count": null, "comment_count": null, "share_count": null, "format": "text|image|carousel|video|reel|link|live", "image_description": "", "link": "", "comments": [{"name": "", "reactions": 0, "text": "", "replies": [{"name": "", "reactions": 0, "text": ""}]}]}

- is_post: false when the image shows no post and no comments.
- posted_ago: the time label exactly as shown, e.g. "5 giờ", "Hôm qua lúc 20:15", "15 tháng 9 lúc 09:30".
- posted_at: that time as ISO 8601 with +07:00, worked out from posted_ago and the current time given to you; empty when there is no time label.
- text: the post text exactly as shown, keeping line breaks. cut_off: true when it ends in "Xem thêm" or "See more".
- Counts: numbers as shown, converted: "1,2K" or "1,2 N" is 1200, "3 Tr" is 3000000. null when not shown. The number beside the reactions icons is reaction_count.
- format: image when the post carries one picture, carousel for several, video, reel, link for a link preview, text otherwise.
- image_description: one or two sentences on what the post's own picture or video shows, including any text written on it.
- link: a post URL if one is visible, else empty.
- comments: every visible comment with the commenter's name, its reaction count (0 when none is shown) and text, replies nested. A screenshot of comments only still fills comments.

parameters.text: =Current time: {{ $now.setZone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh').toFormat("cccc dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm") }} (Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh). This is screenshot {{ $('Screenshots').item.json.index }} of {{ $('Screenshots').item.json.total }} of the same post. Return the json.

messageValues.message: You explain why a saved social media post works, for the content library of a Vietnamese page that teaches SQL, reporting and data work. Write 3 to 6 sentences in English: the hook, the structure, the angle, the emotion it plays on, and what the counts and comments show about how the audience responded. Mention the post's picture when it matters. Plain text, no lists.

'?') + ' reactions, ' + (r.comment_count ?? '?') + ' comments, ' + (r.share_count ?? '?') + ' shares','', 'Post:', r.text || '(not visible)', '', 'Visible comments:', r.comments || '(none)'].join('\n'); })() }}
